formation.note: Year the experiment was proposed, used as an approximate formation date; the collaboration's founding is not dated in the sources fetched.
formation.quote: DEAR (DAΦNE Exotic Atom Research) (7) in 1995 for the spectroscopy of K-mesic hydrogen atoms

intervals.label: proposal
intervals.note: Year of the proposal; the interval ends at the start of the test runs (2000).
intervals.quote: DEAR (DAΦNE Exotic Atom Research) (7) in 1995 for the spectroscopy of K-mesic hydrogen atoms

intervals.label: test runs and detector optimization
intervals.note: Test runs and detector optimization took place in 2000-2001; the interval ends in 2002 when physics data taking began (year precision).
intervals.quote: After test runs and detector optimization during 2000–2001, DEAR took physics data in 2002.

intervals.label: DAΦNE physics data taking (kaonic nitrogen, then hydrogen)
intervals.note: Year precision. Kaonic nitrogen data in October 2002 and about 60 pb^-1 on hydrogen in December 2002 (Di Falco 2003). The accelerator report (Milardi 2008, arXiv:0803.1450) says the DEAR run lasted 'less than 5 months during 2002-2003'; the 2002 dates of the DEAR physics papers' authors are used.
intervals.quote: After test runs and detector optimization during 2000–2001, DEAR took physics data in 2002.

intervals.label: data taking ended
intervals.note: Year precision; FINUDA was installed in DEAR's interaction region in 2003. Conflict: arXiv:0803.1450 gives 2002-2003 for the DEAR run (see the log).
intervals.quote: The DEAR experiment, concluded in 2002, has measured the de-excitation of kaonic atoms.

summary.plain: The collaboration, with institutes in Canada, Italy, Romania, Austria, Switzerland, Japan, Germany and the United States, that built and ran the DEAR kaonic-atom experiment at Frascati's DAΦNE.
summary.technical: DEAR Collaboration: about 25 authors on the Phys. Rev. Lett. 94, 212302 (2005) paper, from Victoria, INFN-LNF, IFIN-HH Magurele, the Stefan Meyer Institute Vienna, Neuchâtel, RIKEN, TU Munich, Berkeley, Fribourg and Caltech. Membership list not retrieved.
